notes.title: Update Information Ver. 1.08A (2016/10/4)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7307013/7803d686caab795cac8aab7774ffba63f528658f.png
Update Ver.1.08A enables the free-to-play version of Dead or Alive 5 Last Round. 
With the free-to-play version, the number of playable characters and Story mode specifications has been modified.
In order to use locked characters and play the Story Mode separate DLC purchases are required.
People who have purchased Dead or Alive 5 Last Round can continue to play the full game.

notes.title: Free Version Of Dead Or Alive 5 Out Next Week
notes.notes:
If you missed out on playing Dead or Alive 5 Last Round  [official site] because you didn’t feel like paying full price for a fighter you’d probably play a few minutes and forget about, sorry about that. You still have to pay full price if you want to play the full game on Steam, but if you’d still rather not, soon you’ll be able to opt for a cut-down free-to-play version to quell that fighting spirit that’s welling up deep within you.
